# PEN-5026 — no privileged container beside the GitHub publish broker

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`, `src/server/config-schema.ts`,
`src/server/job-manifest.github-publish-broker.test.ts`,
`src/server/job-manifest.github-credential-container-set.test.ts`.

D1's property is that the GitHub push credential lives in a sidecar at uid 1001 that the agent
cannot read into. That property is about the POD, not the broker container. `buildDindSidecar`
renders `privileged: true, runAsUser: 0` in the same pod, and a privileged container never needs
the credential volume mounted: privileged is `setns` into another container's mount namespace, and
it is mounting the node filesystem where the kubelet already wrote the Secret. The agent is handed
that sidecar's docker socket, so it can start further privileged containers with arbitrary host
mounts.

PEN-5017 pinned `enableDocker`/`dockerImage` to agent scope, closing the lower-scope route. This
closes the remaining one: with the broker on, `buildJobManifest` now THROWS if any container other
than the broker is privileged, escalation-capable, or holds a container-escaping capability.

Checked as a PROPERTY of the assembled pod spec (`findPrivilegedContainersBesideBroker`), not as a
config key. PEN-3183 §7.5 states that its key list "is as complete as its last edit" and records
that weakness firing twice; a third list entry would inherit it. The discriminator is PRIVILEGE,
NOT UID — PEN-4932's `seed-writable-dirs` runs at uid 0 by necessity and co-occurs with the broker,
so refusing on uid 0 would make the broker unrenderable. `allowPrivilegeEscalation` trips when
UNSET as well as true, because Kubernetes defaults it to true.

Also corrects a test this supersedes: PEN-4990's "broker ON + DinD — the sidecar changes nothing"
asserted a credential-route map that was accurate while its conclusion was wrong — a route map
cannot see privilege. It is replaced in place by the refusal, in the same file, so the next person
extending that table meets it.

Decision recorded with grounds, cost and release condition in
`docs/security/PEN-3183-git-egress-enforcement-boundary-decision.md` §7.6; §8 now forbids weakening
it without returning there. No behaviour changes for any agent today: `enableGitHubPublishBroker` is
false fleet-wide, and all 11 agents readable from the Security seat carry neither key.
